targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS count FROM agent_run WHERE completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'COMPLETE') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "Success Rate" FROM agent_run WHERE completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc)
SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at_utc) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Rate Limits" FROM v_run_metrics WHERE is_rate_limited = true AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT card_id, ROUND((cycle_time_seconds / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Cycle Time (h)", ROUND((working_time_seconds / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Working (h)", ROUND((waiting_time_seconds / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Waiting (h)" FROM v_card_metrics ORDER BY cycle_time_seconds DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT step_name, role, ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds / 60)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Duration (min)" FROM v_step_duration WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) GROUP BY step_name, role ORDER BY "Avg Duration (min)" DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT card_id, state_name, entry_count, rework_count FROM v_card_rework ORDER BY rework_count DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at_utc) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'COMPLETE') AS "Complete", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'ERROR') AS "Error", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'NEEDS_INFO') AS "Needs Info" FROM agent_run WHERE completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_estimate AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (card_id) card_id, estimate FROM agent_run WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL AND completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND estimate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY card_id, started_at_utc DESC), card_cycle AS (SELECT ar.card_id, le.estimate, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(ar.completed_at_utc) - MIN(ar.started_at_utc))) AS cycle_time_seconds FROM agent_run ar JOIN latest_estimate le ON ar.card_id = le.card_id WHERE ar.completed_at_utc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ar.card_id, le.estimate), per_point AS (SELECT cycle_time_seconds / NULLIF(estimate, 0) AS cpp FROM card_cycle WHERE estimate > 0) SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND((AVG(cpp) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg h/pt", ROUND((COALESCE(STDDEV(cpp), 0) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Std Dev h/pt" FROM per_point

panels.title: Candidate Win Rate by Provider × Role
panels.description: Per-(role, provider) win rate from v_provider_role_metrics. Rows appear only for combinations that have participated in at least one candidate group.

targets.rawSql: SELECT role || ' / ' || provider AS metric, win_rate_percent AS value FROM v_provider_role_metrics WHERE win_rate_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY role, provider

panels.title: Avg Quality Score by Provider × Role
panels.description: Mean evaluator quality score (0–10) per (role, provider). Surfaces the 'how close was it' signal that win rate alone hides.

targets.rawSql: SELECT role || ' / ' || provider AS metric, ROUND(avg_quality_score::numeric, 2) AS value FROM v_provider_role_metrics WHERE avg_quality_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY role, provider
